title: Bands and dances at San Jacinto, Frank Pena and Mitchell's own ball
summary: Harold names bands that played the big hall (Don Albert, Sam Morgan, Celestin, Buddy Petit, Tuxedo); Frank Pena of the Dewdrop sponsored dances, and Mitchell ran his own ball in the 1940s.
